prompt: Can you check nearby retailers for Instacart in zip code 90210 using the REST API?
expected: Uses Developer Platform REST GET /idp/v1/retailers with postal_code=90210 and country_code=US (or asks to confirm CA), Bearer auth, and treats retailer_key as organization-level metadata rather than a store inventory guarantee.
actual: Use development REST host https://connect.dev.instacart.tools unless production is approved. Call GET /idp/v1/retailers?postal_code=90210&country_code=US with Authorization: Bearer $INSTACART_API_KEY and Accept: application/json. Parse retailers[].retailer_key/name as organization-level selection hints, not specific store ids or stock guarantees. MCP create tools cannot replace this lookup.

prompt: Create a new shopping list for taco night on Instacart.
expected: Chooses Developer Platform MCP create-shopping-list or REST POST /idp/v1/products/products_link, keeps item names generic, uses supported units, avoids mixing product_ids and upcs, and returns/caches products_link_url without claiming order placement.
actual: Default to MCP create-shopping-list when only page creation is needed; otherwise POST /idp/v1/products/products_link with title and line_items whose name fields stay generic (tortillas, ground beef, salsa) and countable units like each. Do not send both product_ids and upcs on one item. Return the products_link_url, cache it under <state_root>/url-cache.md by normalized payload+env, and clarify the user still selects a store and checks out on Instacart.

prompt: We need delivery windows and order tracking inside our branded store site—should we use the recipe page API?
expected: Routes away from Developer Platform page APIs to Instacart Connect for branded ecommerce, fulfillment, delivery/pickup, and post-checkout; explains Developer Platform only yields Marketplace page links.
actual: No—delivery windows, fulfillment, and order tracking are Connect partner capabilities. Developer Platform recipe/shopping-list APIs only create Marketplace page links where the shopper completes store selection and checkout. Keep Developer Platform for shoppable links; move this requirement to Connect auth and guides.
